description: Covers B6, B28, B43. wsc reg remove <reg> <id> deletes a row (its file in dir storage) after checking no x-ref points at it (B28); the job queue stamps a tool's last_used when a job report cites it, and C9 retirement warnings come back on (B6); wsc find hands exe-shaped words to the exe string index (discovery/exe_strings.py find, from W4) instead of indexing the strings into a registry (B43).
title: Registry verbs: reg remove, last_used stamping, exe words in find
